message.content:
**Union Square Greenmarket** – the largest and most‑visited farmers’ market in New York City.

| Metric | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| **Location** | 14th St. & Union Square, Manhattan |
| **Annual Foot‑Traffic** | Roughly **1.5 million visitors** (NYC Dept. of Agriculture & Markets, 2019) |
| **Season** | Open year‑round (winter‑to‑winter) |
| **Offerings** | Fresh produce, artisanal foods, local crafts, and seasonal specialties |
| **Why it’s the most visited** | Its central location, extensive vendor mix, and year‑long schedule make it a destination for both locals and tourists. |

> *“Union Square Greenmarket is the largest farmers’ market in the city and consistently draws the highest number of visitors among all NYC markets.”* – NYC Dept. of Agriculture & Markets

If you’re planning a visit, the market is busiest on Saturdays and Sundays, especially during the summer months. It’s a great spot to sample local produce, meet the growers, and soak up the vibrant street‑market atmosphere.
